slides.reasoning: Both are on-palette and clean, but A's condensed lime headline, oversized $4.8M and dramatic full-height curve create a stronger single hierarchy, whereas B lets a floating top-right metric overpower its own headline.

B correctly makes clay the dominant field with blush/marigold accents and delivers a genuinely illustrated, hand-drawn route with taped note and buddy tag, while A inverts the palette dominance, leans on a soft background gradient, and reverts to three text columns beneath the path.

B's tangled-network vs. ordered-identity-graph panels read the before/after transformation in under a second with equal-weight boxes and a clean ROI band, whereas A's left panel uses a weak decorative squiggle and its top-right customer-model block competes with the headline.

B stays strictly within evergreen/gold/coral/mineral with more restrained, institutional serif detailing and clean leader-lined labels, while A introduces an off-palette sage segment and lets the '20%' label collide with the faint orbital ring.

B's exploded driver stack is a credible keynote hero with spare, well-spaced callouts, whereas A's flat headphone illustration reads brochure-like, duplicates specs in a table, and pushes annotation text almost to the right trim.

B uses the full canvas in balanced quadrants with an even, correctly scaled axis and consistent monospaced variance markers, while A's chart has uneven y-axis intervals and leaves a noticeable dead zone under the right-hand scorecard.

A fills the frame with a bolder wayfinding diagram, complete pillar descriptions and a strong charcoal north-star band, while B leaves the entire upper-right quadrant empty and compresses the pillar copy into station labels.

B's cascading chevron phases name a decision owner at every gate with precise week-ruler alignment and generous footer margins, whereas A's launch-ramp labels sit flush against the bottom trim and its week-scale numerals render awkwardly.

B's heavy arrowed loop plus marker-annotated, line-by-line dissection of the opener is far more instructional and cleanly gridded, while A's loop lacks directional clarity and its 'Commit' label breaks the left margin, nearly touching the edge.

B pairs a memorable waffle-grid 68% with a truly fragmented journey diagram showing where confidence breaks, all rigorously aligned, whereas A's middle column floats and its footer band produces an orphaned 'PERTH' line.

B's solid-to-outline title and auditorium silhouette deliver the requested back-of-the-room keynote moment with no collisions, while A's stacked title letters visibly overlap and its boxed UI diagram feels like a generic slide chart.

B's split orange/powder-blue field with genuinely oversized editorial numerals and rule-separated rows better matches the brief's typographic tone, while A's four-across metric row plus two panels reads more like a dashboard with minor label orphans.

B makes the sage corridor map the full-bleed emotional centerpiece with a taped field-ledger card and parcel-level close-up detail, while A's safer panel-plus-map split reduces the map to an illustration beside an info rail.

B's letterform is genuinely enormous with a yellow-filled counter, measured aperture and baseline-shared specimen comparison, whereas A's 'a' is comparatively small and its x-height/baseline labels sit almost on the left trim.

B's halftone citrus macro and dotted-leader editorial column are cleanly spaced and far more collage-like, while A's flat clip-art fruit and the collision between '41 countries represented' and the partnership list crowd the mid-right.
